# ⚡ Sportz WebSocket Server

[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-18+-339933.svg?logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.9-3178C6.svg?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)
[![Express](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express-5.2-000000.svg?logo=express&logoColor=white)](https://expressjs.com/)
[![WebSocket](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebSocket-ws_8.19-010101.svg)](https://github.com/websockets/ws)
[![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-Neon-4169E1.svg?logo=postgresql&logoColor=white)](https://neon.tech/)
[![Drizzle ORM](https://img.shields.io/badge/Drizzle_ORM-0.45-C5F74F.svg)](https://orm.drizzle.team/)
[![Arcjet](https://img.shields.io/badge/Arcjet-Security-7C3AED.svg)](https://arcjet.com/)
[![Zod](https://img.shields.io/badge/Zod-4.3-3E67B1.svg)](https://zod.dev/)

> Real-time sports match tracking server with live commentary broadcasting via WebSocket pub/sub, backed by Express 5, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, and Arcjet security — built entirely in TypeScript.

---

## 🏗️ Architecture Overview

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     HTTP Server (Express 5)                │
│                                                            │
│  ┌───────────┐   ┌────────────────┐   ┌──────────────────┐ │
│  │  Arcjet   │──▶│  REST API v1   │──▶│  Controllers     │ │
│  │ Middleware│   │  /api/v1/...   │   │  Match │ Comment │ │
│  └───────────┘   └────────────────┘   └────────┬─────────┘ │
│                                                │           │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────┐          │           │
│  │  WebSocket Server (/ws)          │          │           │
│  │  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  │          ▼           │
│  │  │ Arcjet   │  │  Pub/Sub     │  │  ┌──────────────┐    │
│  │  │ Upgrade  │  │  Engine      │◀─┼──│  Broadcast   │    │
│  │  │ Guard    │  │  (per-match) │  │  │  Bridge      │    │
│  │  └──────────┘  └──────────────┘  │  └──────────────┘    │
│  └──────────────────────────────────┘                      │
│                         │                                  │
│                         ▼                                  │
│              ┌────────────────────┐                        │
│              │  PostgreSQL (Neon) │                        │
│              │  via Drizzle ORM   │                        │
│              └────────────────────┘                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**How it works:** REST API endpoints create matches and commentary entries, which are persisted to PostgreSQL via Drizzle ORM. On every write, the broadcast bridge pushes real-time updates through the WebSocket pub/sub engine to all subscribed clients — zero polling, instant delivery.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🔌 **WebSocket Pub/Sub** — Per-match subscription model with real-time commentary broadcasting
- 🏟️ **Match Management** — Full CRUD for sports matches with automatic status determination (scheduled → live → finished)
- 📝 **Live Commentary** — Structured commentary entries with minute, period, event type, actors, and metadata
- 🛡️ **Dual-Layer Security** — Arcjet protection on both HTTP middleware and WebSocket upgrade phase (shield + bot detection + rate limiting)
- 🗃️ **Type-Safe ORM** — Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL, fully typed schema with migrations
